title: Write Lifecycle Transition
description: Move a node's lifecycle forward, writing both the node and an audit row in one action.
signature: pub fn write_transition(&self, node: &mut Node, to: Lifecycle, actor: Actor, actor_name: &str, at: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<AuditRow>
semantics: Reads the node from disk to verify the claimed lifecycle, checks the transition is legal, writes both the updated node and an audit row, or rolls back the node on audit failure.
